about_the_game:
Cat Secretary is the story of a cat who becomes a <WARNING: Spoilers ahead!!!> secretary.

When a homeless cat joined the ranks of a multinational conglomerate obsessed with infinite growth, they had no idea there would be a dark side. Fortunately, cats can see great in the dark. Join Cat as they start climbing their way up the ladder, knocking plants off tables, and unspooling a dark plot at the heart of the company. Can Cat nip this conspiracy in the bud?

Uncover the Dark Secrets of a Media Empire

Try to imagine one company owning all of the most important intellectual properties in the world. A juggernaut studio with its own publishing company, recording studio, and theme parks. A corporation that is slowly replacing human storytelling with profit-motivated, AI-assisted soulless content creation. It sounds impossible, but this is increasingly the state of DOX, Inc.

As your Cat starts on the ground floor, they scratch the not-so-fluffy underbelly of DOX to see what secrets it holds. With the help of an eccentric Chief Creative Officer and the staff of MouseCorp, (a smaller company that works within the walls of DOX), Cat Secretary works their way to the top uncovering old histories and untold mysteries.


Solve Puzzles by Night

Use your wits and special abilities to undermine DOX’s new automated Night Staff! Investigate your colleagues' desks and learn their problems, then improve office morale the only way a Cat Secretary would: at your own pace while getting distracted by cool moving lights.

Keep Your Day Job

Don’t forget, you still have a job to do! Complete a variety of mini-games to stay productive each day! Earn DOXBUX to make yourself even more efficient! Decorate the main lobby to your feline liking! Answer Cat-calls! Cat-alogue archives! Cat-ch problems to avoid cat-astrophe! Install Cat-heters in Cat-atonic Cat-holic Cat-erers recovering from Cat-aract surgery! Well... not that last one. CAT CAT CAT CAT CAT!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space

short_description: Keep your job by day. At night, sneak around the office and solve your colleagues' problems. Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!
